title: AirStack registry module entry (modules/<name>.yaml)
description: One registered module in the airstack-modules-index (RFC #379 §7, rosdistro pattern). Identity, source pin, and the DECLARED compatibility range only — the VERIFIED compatibility matrix lives in compat/<name>.yaml and is CI-stamped, never hand-edited. Consumed by tools/validate_entry.py, which interprets the same draft-07 subset as trunk's tools/validate_module.py (type, required, properties, enum, pattern, minLength, additionalProperties) plus the x-airstack-format annotations.

name.description: Module identity — must match the `name` in the module repo's module.yaml (lowercase snake_case, starts with a letter). Also the entry filename: modules/<name>.yaml.

repo.description: HTTPS GitHub URL of the module repo (no trailing slash, no .git suffix).

description.description: One-line human description shown in the marketplace catalog — normally copied from module.yaml.

maintainer.description: Named maintainer email — required by governance (RFC #379 §8); the canary escalation target.

license.description: SPDX-style license string — checked at registration (RFC #379 §8) and surfaced in the catalog so e.g. a GPL module in an overlay chain is visible, not buried.

type.description: Module type — the same enum as module.yaml (platform is future, RFC #380 §6).

registered_ref.description: The module ref this entry registers: a full 40-hex commit SHA or a tag (vX.Y.Z). Never a branch name — branch refs rot silently.

airstack_compat.description: DECLARED compatibility range vs trunk .env VERSION, copied from the module's module.yaml. This is the author's claim; the VERIFIED matrix is compat/<name>.yaml, stamped only by CI runs.

notes.description: Optional free-text registration notes (pending tags, validation provenance, placeholders to resolve).
